positions.name: MeridianGateMandateScope
positions.frame: What is required before a Meridian deploy ships, and where does that requirement reach?
positions.why: src-1 (the directive establishing the signed-manifest requirement), src-3 (the declarative Gate entry restating it), and src-4 (the declarative Scope entry delimiting it to staging and production) share one authority-ranking, legitimate-power directional read — the same mandate performed twice, once in prose-directive register and once in the bolded spec-label register, but enacting the identical act of establishing-and-delimiting a requirement. Held in tension: src-1 speaks informally ('now requires... before it ships') while src-3/src-4 speak as formal record entries, yet both are readable as the same governing act rather than distinct claims.
